head: Xfinity gives a free 2 Gbps speed boost for 15 days for GTA 6
dek: Xfinity is giving eligible internet customers a free 15-day boost to up to 2 Gbps download speeds, as GTA 6 pre-loads need up to 212 GB.
details: Comcast says that's enough to download GTA 6 in as little as 30 minutes. Spectrum had promised its customers a free gig upgrade too. Rockstar opened pre-loads on 10 November.
means: If you're downloading GTA 6 on Xfinity, it can finish much faster.
todo: Turn on the boost in the Xfinity app or at xfinity.com/membership, then start your download.
